welcome.title: Welcome to Overberg Skills Connect
welcome.body: You can now advertise your skills, find local help, or manage your profile.

page.title: My Profile
page.subtitle: Manage your details, your skills listing, and any service requests — all in one place.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unread: {{count}} new — check your profile regularly, we do not send SMS messages
notifications.checkRegularly: Check your profile regularly. Updates appear here, not by SMS.
notifications.markAllReadError: Could not mark notifications as read. Please try again.

details.title: My Details
details.subtitle: Your account information. Only you can see and edit this.

listing.title: My Skills Listing
listing.subtitle: Share your skills so people in your area can find you.
listing.empty: You have not advertised any skills yet.
listing.notVisible: Your account is registered, but your skills are not yet visible to the community.
listing.notVisibleHelp: That is perfectly fine if you joined to find someone. Whenever you are ready, add your skills so local people can find you.

incoming.title: People Interested In My Services
incoming.subtitle: Requests from people who want to hire or contact you.
incoming.empty: No one has requested your details yet.
incoming.loadError: We could not load your requests right now.

outgoing.title: My Service Requests
outgoing.subtitle: Requests you've sent to service providers.
outgoing.empty: You haven't sent any requests yet.
outgoing.waiting: Waiting for the service provider to respond.
outgoing.acceptedMessage: Your service request has been accepted. You may now contact the service provider directly.
outgoing.notAvailable: This service provider is not available for this request.
outgoing.accessEndedMessage: The service provider ended access to their contact details.
outgoing.whatsappMessage: Hi {{name}}, I'm reaching out via Overberg Skills Connect about my service request.

favourites.title: My Favourites
favourites.subtitle: People you have saved. Only you can see this list.
favourites.emptyPrefix: You have not saved anyone yet. Open someone's listing and tap
favourites.notAvailable: This listing is not available at the moment.
favourites.removeError: Sorry, we could not remove that. Please try again.

listingSection.pausedInfo: Pausing keeps everything saved. Nothing is deleted.
listingSection.liveInfo: People can find you and ask for your number.

accountManagement.title: My Account
accountManagement.subtitle: Close your account and remove your information.
accountManagement.body: Deleting your account removes your skills listing, your saved favourites and your personal details. This cannot be undone. If you only want a break, pause your listing instead.
accountManagement.deleteError: Sorry, we could not delete your account. Please try again or contact support.
accountManagement.deletedToast: Your account and listing have been deleted.
accountManagement.confirmBody: Step 1 of 2. Everything below will be removed permanently: your listing, your skills, your favourites and your personal details.
accountManagement.confirmAck: I understand this cannot be undone.
